# Replace Workstation's copied preview pipeline with engine ownership

## Context

Workspace supplies its own previewFor/clearPreview/hitTest wiring to Participation, plus resolveCrossWindowPreviewSurface, ensureCrossWindowPreviewGeometry, renderCrossWindowPreview, renderMainCrossWindowPreview and a geometry map. Participation now owns resolveAffordances, default preview/clear paths and complete renderer/indicator composition when a real workspace is supplied. Full PopupWorkspace owners also exist.

This is a leaf of the dedicated Workstation consumer-refactoring epic. The shared outcome is a ≤1,000-total-line composition entrypoint with working ordinary docking and optional scripted demos.

## The Problem

The named responsibility currently lives on `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`, coupling its state, caller surface and teardown to the root. This leaf removes that responsibility and updates its actual callers in the same PR; it does not create a forwarding method for every moved member.

## The Architectural Reality

Placement pre-flight: first prefer deletion/adoption through existing src/dashboard/dock/window/Participation and interaction owners; no new engine file is prescribed. App policy, if demonstrated, uses an ordinary registered app owner rather than a raw helper. The actual popup owner is already apps/workstation/view/PopupWorkspace.

Final placement: the saved-home policy is `apps/workstation/window/Participation.mjs`, mirroring the engine Participation namespace and extending that registered class. The earlier `view/PopupWorkspace` reference identifies the existing rendered popup owner; the non-view policy belongs in the app's window domain.

## The Fix

Bind Participation to the actual main or popup Workspace and use its existing preview/clear/geometry ownership where the production behavior is equivalent. Trace each Workstation override before removal, including the stored-home/native-drag behavior and shared main renderer. Keep only a small, evidenced product-policy difference as an explicit policy surface. If an engine primitive cannot express a required behavior, file/link the owning engine gap and block the dependent consumer cut rather than recreating the pipeline in another app helper.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cross-window preview selection and rendering | Workspace.createCrossWindowParticipation and preview methods; Participation.resolveAffordances/defaultClearPreview | Existing engine owner supplies preview, indicator and geometry lifecycle | Current fail-closed target refusal | Retained policy JSDoc | Main/popup preview-to-drop symmetry and cancellation |
| Overlay ownership | Main dragAffordances and full PopupWorkspace | Reuse or own each renderer/controller exactly once | Destroying participation releases only what it owns | Creator/borrower contract | Overlay identity and cleanup assertions |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every removed override has a source/caller disposition; any surviving app-specific behavior has a demonstrated product reason, not merely a matching method name.
- [ ] The app's copied preview/measurement pipeline and its mutable state are deleted in the same PR wherever engine defaults replace them; no parallel app controller hides the same code. Record the Workspace entrypoint's before/after total physical line count and any moved owner's count in the PR.
- [ ] Real main and popup paths preserve root/local target identity, full affordances, stored-home behavior where applicable, cancel/leave cleanup and preview/commit symmetry.
- [ ] Participation refresh/rebind and destruction do not create duplicate overlays or destroy borrowed main affordances.
- [ ] Existing WorkstationDockPreviewSymmetryNL and the relevant cross-window/native preview witnesses pass at the final head, with a default-owner control proving the path under test rather than a still-active custom callback.
- [ ] Any required engine change is an explicit linked prerequisite with its own owner and evidence before this leaf is merged.

## Out of Scope

New arbitration, Group ownership, operation semantics, broad Participation redesign, and unrelated engine bug fixes.

## Avoided Traps

No giant helper or copied post-setup factory descriptors; no shadow Group/document registry; no feature removal or weakened assertions to meet the size bar. Preserve explicit creator/borrower cleanup. Existing defects require baseline attribution rather than a false green.

## Decision Record impact

Aligned with ADR 0029; preserves existing engine operation, Group, projection and native-window contracts. Any required engine-contract change must be separately authorized and linked before this leaf merges.

## Source disposition for pickup

Revalidated at dev `6648921e48581cea97ab01d6f8509c0217aac218`: the inspected Workspace, PopupWorkspace and Participation blobs match the source used below. This is a source map, not runtime equivalence evidence.

| Existing app surface | Existing engine owner / disposition to verify |
|---|---|
| Main `affordances: me.dragAffordances` | Participation.resolveAffordances already returns the supplied controller; preserve this borrowing and prove refresh/destruction does not duplicate or destroy it. |
| Popup `workspace: null` and manual preview/geometry pipeline | Full `PopupWorkspace` instances already exist as `state.host`; bind the actual workspace so Participation can compose its defaults. Reconcile the old `state.preview` / `state.indicators` users before deleting their producer. |
| Main indicator-feed callback and ordinary on-zone rendering | Participation.defaultPreviewFor uses ensureGeometry → resolvePreview → renderPreview. Prove indicator readiness and exact target identity through this default path before cutting the copied feed. |
| Main off-zone stored-home fallback | Workstation.renderMainCrossWindowPreview falls back to the stored-home tabs center after resolvePreview returns null. Participation.defaultPreviewFor has no such branch. Preserve or explicitly disposition this app policy; a successful ordinary hover is not proof of equivalence. |
| Popup fallback to tab-into at the whole landing surface's center | Workstation.renderCrossWindowPreview deliberately centers its fallback pointer while hovered indicators retain alternatives. Compare this with the default pointer-driven resolver on a real full popup; do not silently change the native drop policy. |
| Geometry map and clear/rebind state | Engine defaults clear their supplied/owned controller. The current app callback additionally deletes its geometry entry and may clear an uncommitted popup document. Trace those writes and callers before removing them; visual cleanup alone does not prove lifecycle equivalence. |

The policy exceptions above do not justify moving the complete preview pipeline into a new app helper. Keep a surviving product difference small and explicit, with the existing preview/commit symmetry witnesses as the acceptance authority.
